blurb: The Dance Academy offers a defined curriculum progressing from fundamental to advanced levels in multiple dance styles including ballet, Latin Fusion, Musical Theatre, Tap, Hip Hop, Jazz, Lyrical/Contemporary, and Pre-dance for ages 3-5. Students are evaluated and placed in appropriate classes to facilitate individual development. Performance opportunities include an annual recital and local productions.
extraNote: No prorate, refund or credit for unattended classes · Withdrawal requires notification to fill place from waiting list · Full tuition expected during months with holidays; make-up classes offered · Late payment fee $30 after 15th of month · One-time registration fee $50 per student · Returned check fee $30 · Attendance mandatory for recital rehearsals and performances · No food, drinks, or gum allowed in studio or theatre · No personal taping allowed at performances or rehearsals
